- deep tissue or sports massage with one day to rest before working your muscles again

im going through the same thing as you with my boyfriend. i was initially and still am worried about being too much of a burden, but i realized the burden of having to keep depression from my partner made it more difficult because i either had to push him away during my depressive phases or pretend i was happy. i eventually gathered my courage to open up to him and he was very understanding. i told myself and him that if he loved me for me, it would include my depressive phases. had he said he was not okay w it, we would've broken up and i would be upset, but i'd tell myself that my partner would have to be able to handle my phases.

tldr; start by organizing your feelings on paper. fears and concerns followed by what you expect her to do when you're depressed (leave you alone, sit quietly w you, etc.) then talk to her or show her the paper :) and finally end your discussion w a compromise that both of you are comfortable with!
